test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 1 Aug 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'BLISS' is written as '56' and 'FORD' is written as '39'. How will 'TENT' be written in that language?
solution: According to the English alphabets and their positional values: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2279b560b10991887192eff3a548e57e9b0820d787d416555b032b86f014a220.png] The pattern followed in the given codes is: **The code is equal to the sum of the positional values of alphabets - number of alphabets.**
